title: Repair invalid GitHub Actions setup-node immutable pin

forbidden: No Git or GitHub command, no commit/push/release/deployment, and no Docker/local integration run.
No changing CI quality commands, permissions, triggers, credential construction, or cleanup lifecycle.
requirements: Replace only the invalid setup-node SHA with 49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020.
Keep checkout pinned and all action pins immutable full 40-character commit SHA values.
Update static verifier/tests only if their expected immutable pins require it; preserve negative coverage.
Record RED evidence against the failed hosted run and GREEN evidence from local static verifier/test.
acceptance: Workflow action reference uses the verified setup-node SHA and remains SHA-pinned.
